paper.title: On the Last Kervaire Invariant Problem
paper.attribution: Original authorship and all source notices are retained verbatim. This migration does not claim authorship of the article.

migration.naming: The source repository calls this directory MainPaper; the source registry calls the paper aim_paper. AimPaper is the PascalCase destination for the user-requested aimpaper assets.
migration.readme_policy: No README or AGENTS file is added or changed. The source README metadata relevant to labels is recorded below.
migration.build_policy: These are offline reference assets. No paper typesetting or Blueprint migration/check is claimed.

responsibility_policy.main_endpoint: Nonzero permanent survival of the standard h6-square in the fixed classical sphere Adams spectral sequence, at bidegree (s,t)=(2,128).
responsibility_policy.main_owns: Article-local arguments, including the differential reduction, C3/C4/C5 reasoning, local applicability/choice-independence work, alpha-one and local Toda/nu/extension arguments, and the final theorem.
responsibility_policy.upstream_owned: Objects, constructions, comparison laws, cited external theorems and computation interpretation belong to their SpectralSequence, AdamsSynthetic, Literature or Computation owners. An upstream sorry remains an upstream responsibility and is not duplicated as a Main proof obligation.
responsibility_policy.consumer_api: Main directly uses fixed public upstream objects and callable theorems. No Challenge or caller-supplied result package is required. Genuine mathematical hypotheses are retained.
responsibility_policy.paper_tools: Reusable tools developed by this article, including stretching and generalized Leibniz/Mahowald, remain ProofTools proof responsibilities. Placement upstream of Main does not reclassify them as accepted external literature.
responsibility_policy.source_status: Article statements, citation records, table transcription, file hashes and successful compilation are not formal proof-completion evidence.
scope_limits: Geometric Kervaire existence and the all-dimensions classification are outside the retained formal endpoint.
The open questions about order-two theta-six and theta-five-square-zero are not proof obligations.
A cited external theorem must retain its original range and conditions; source-to-selected-model transport remains an upstream obligation.
